br.br:
1. An aircraft passenger seat unit comprising:
a seat;
a privacy shell at least partially surrounding the seat, the privacy shell having a primary opening to allow entry to and exit from the seat unit;
a storage unit comprising one or more holders for supporting clothes stored in the storage unit, and being located against an interior face of the privacy shell adjacent the primary opening;
a door, movable in relation to the storage unit between a first position in which the door at least partially blocks off the primary opening, and a second position in which the door at least partially closes access to holders of the storage unit.
2. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 1, wherein the door in the first position fully blocks off the primary opening.
3. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the door comprises a movable or removable portion, and wherein moving or removal of the portion provides a user with a secondary opening to allow an emergency exit from the seat unit when the door is in the first position.
4. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 3, wherein the removable portion is frangible, such that the removable portion can be broken from the rest of the door to provide the secondary opening.
5. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the storage unit is fixed in relation to the privacy shell.
6. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the holders of the storage unit are located at least 20cm above a floor of the aircraft passenger seat unit.
7. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the storage unit is a wardrobe.
8. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the one or more holders of the storage unit comprise a number of a hooks, shelves, and/or
rails.
9. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the door is arranged to slide between the first position and the second position.
10. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein a back side of the storage unit is located against the interior face of the privacy shell and wherein a front side of the storage unit provides access to the holders of the storage unit when the door is in the second position.
11. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 10, wherein a depth of the storage unit between the front side and the back side is deeper at a first end of the storage unit than at a second end of the storage unit.
12. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 11, wherein the first end of the storage unit is distal from the primary opening and the second end of the storage unit is proximate the opening.
13. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the door is arranged to move between the first position and the second position in a direction offset from an angle of the interior face of the privacy shell.
14. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the privacy shell extends to a height of at least 100cm above a floor of the aircraft passenger seat unit.
15. An aircraft passenger seat unit comprising:
a seat;
a privacy shell at least partially surrounding the seat, the privacy shell having a primary opening to allow entry to and exit from the seat unit; and
a door, moveable in relation to the primary opening from a first position in which the door fully blocks off the primary opening, so that passenger entry and exit is prevented, and a second position in which the door provides at least partial access to the primary opening.
16. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 15, wherein the door comprises a removable portion, such that removal of the removable portion provides a user with a secondary opening to allow an emergency exit from the seat unit.
17. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 16, wherein the removable portion is frangible, such that the removable portion can be broken from the rest of the door to provide the secondary opening.
18. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any of claims 15 to 17, wherein the door is arranged to slide between the first position and the second position.
19. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any of claims 15 to 18, wherein the privacy shell extends to a height of at least 100cm above a floor of the aircraft passenger seat unit.
20. An aircraft passenger seat unit comprising:
a seat;
a privacy shell at least partially surrounding the seat, the privacy shell having a primary opening to allow entry to and exit from the seat unit; and
a door, movable between a first position in which the door at least partially blocks off the primary opening, and a second position, in which the door provides at least partial access to the primary opening, wherein the door is arranged to move between the first and second positions in a direction offset from an angle of the privacy shell adjacent the opening.
21. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 20, wherein the movement direction of the door is offset from the angle of the privacy screen by between 10 and 300.
22. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any of claims 20 to 22, the door is located further away from a side of the seat unit providing the opening when in the first position than it is when in the second position.
23. An aircraft passenger seat unit according to any of claims 20 to 23, wherein the door is arranged to slide between the first position and the second position. 5 10 15 20 25 30
